guide.airdefense.title: Air Defense guide
guide.airdefense.page.1:
Air Defence — guide

Vehicles and missiles, air defence, radars, drones, the factory, weapons, fuel and logistics, cities and countries, armies and wars.

Turn the page →
guide.airdefense.page.2:
VEHICLES

Place them from the Air Defense tab (right click the ground) or have them made in a village hangar.
Right click a vehicle - get in.
G - change seat.
R - raise or stow the launcher.
Shift - get out.
guide.airdefense.page.3:
TABLET

Right click - the map with your vehicles.
Pick a vehicle, click a target on the map, press Fire.
Shift + right click - mark the block you look at.
guide.airdefense.page.4:
AIR DEFENCE

V - mode: auto / manual / off.
Auto: the vehicle shoots down missiles and drones by itself.
Manual: take the gunner's seat, aim, left click fires.
Stinger: aim at the target, right click.
guide.airdefense.page.5:
FACTORY

Factory kit: right click the ground - the factory builds itself.
Order missiles, drones and ammunition at its desk.
Vehicles nearby are restocked by themselves.
guide.airdefense.page.6:
WEAPONS

Left click - fire, right click - aim, R - reload.
Grenade: right click - throw.
NVG helmet: N - night vision.
The medkit heals.
Ammunition: from the factory or the crafting table.
guide.airdefense.page.7:
VILLAGES

Shift + right click a villager - the village screen.
Make it yours: respect + a charter from the elder for emeralds, or by force: beat the guards, hold the flag for 30 s.
In creative - at once.
guide.airdefense.page.8:
WORK AND BUILDING

Work tab: woodcutters, stonecutters, miners, builders.
Build tab: houses, flats, barracks, hangar, factory, maternity hospital, warehouse, roads.
Hangar tab: vehicles.
guide.airdefense.page.9:
ARMY

Village screen: Call up.
Tablet, Army tab: pick the village, a point on the map, press To point.
A barracks allows more soldiers and heals them.
guide.airdefense.page.10:
PEOPLE

Children are born while there are free beds - build houses. A maternity hospital speeds it up.
Feed villagers bread by hand.
Mind the village's mood, or it may riot.
guide.airdefense.page.11:
WARS

On another country's village screen: Declare war or Propose peace.
The enemy sends squads - keep guards and soldiers at your flags.
Peace can be bought with emeralds.
guide.airdefense.page.12:
IN CREATIVE

Everything is free: buildings go up in seconds, the hangar needs no resources, any village can be taken at once.

Good luck, commander!

guide.airdefense.page.13:
RADARS AND DRONES

A radar goes down like a vehicle and turns by itself. What it sees is on the Radar tab of the tablet.

Give a Shahed a flight plan, watch through its camera; Mass strike sends a whole wave.
guide.airdefense.page.14:
TANKS, BOATS, AIRCRAFT

Get in (RMB), aim with the mouse, LMB fires.
Boats: RMB on water.
Helicopter: Space/Ctrl up/down, W/S nose down/up (to fly on), A/D bank.
Plane: W/S throttle, flies where you look.
All need fuel: a jerrycan, RMB on the vehicle.
guide.airdefense.page.15:
FUEL AND LOGISTICS

Oil wells pump oil, the refinery makes fuel, the hub makes ammunition.
Vehicles fill up at a gas station; at a hub they are rearmed too.
Trucks: R switches the mode (load, unload, serve).
guide.airdefense.page.16:
CITIES AND COUNTRIES

Every country has a capital and two more towns joined by asphalt roads.
Buy a charter or take the flag and a town is yours.
On the tablet map (Army tab) click a building to pull it down or rebuild it.
guide.airdefense.page.17:
FPV AND MAGURA

FPV drone: RMB to take off, flies where you look, blows up on impact.
Magura: RMB on water, goes where you look, sinks boats.
Sneak to let go.

guide.airdefense.page.18:
FOOD, WEAPONS, MARKET

Farms and the food plant feed a city. Hunger: anger, no children.
Arms factory: iron+fuel → weapons (for soldiers, for ammo).
Every city lacks something (a refinery, oil...) - truck it in. Market: trade for emeralds.

guide.airdefense.page.19:
ARSENAL

35 guns in the "Small arms" tab.
Shotguns fire 8 pellets, M16A4 three-round bursts.
Scopes: SVD, VSS, M110, AWM, M82, SV-98.
RPG-22, AT4, NLAW: one shot.
Javelin: keep the vehicle in the sight 2 s, then fire - it hits from above.

guide.airdefense.page.20:
IRON DOME AND SIRENS

Iron Dome: 20 Tamirs, best against rockets, shells and drones. It lets what falls in empty fields go.

Sirens: on the tablet map - "Air raid alert". Alert or all clear in a town, everywhere, or one siren. They also sound by themselves when a raid comes.
tooltip.airdefense.siren: On the ground it goes up on a 6 m mast; sneak to put just the siren (on a roof)
nation.airdefense.war.column: %s sends %s soldiers in %s vehicles against %s by road!
guide.airdefense.page.21:
THE MAP

The tablet shows 10 km round the spawn: the countries' borders, every town's and village's own bounds, highways and country roads, the depots.
Scroll to zoom; furthest out you see it all.
guide.airdefense.page.22:
TOWN ARSENALS

Every town and village has its own air defence and launchers. In a war they fire at the enemy's towns themselves.
Factories make missiles from iron and fuel, lorries bring them in. Stores are limited.
guide.airdefense.page.23:
COLUMNS

The enemy comes by road: a car for a few men, a carrier and a lorry for more, a column led by a tank for many.
At the edge of town they get out, take cover, fall back when hurt, throw grenades.
hud.airdefense.sight.keys: LMB - fire · %s - out of the sight · %s - magnification · %s - thermal · %s - smoke · WASD - drive
guide.airdefense.page.24:
THE CREW

Tank, IFV, APC, armoured car, gunboat: you sit at the gun sight at once.
C - sight / seat
Z - magnification 1x, 3.5x, 8x
N - thermal imager
X - smoke grenades (the enemy cannot see through)
LMB - fire, WASD - drive.
guide.airdefense.page.25:
CABINS

Every truck, launcher, radar and armoured car has a cab inside: dials, a wheel that turns with the wheels, seats, a radio. The glass is see-through when you are near.
A tank driver with a gunner aboard: C - the periscope.
guide.airdefense.page.26:
PLANES AND HELICOPTERS

Plane: look where to fly - it banks into the turn by itself. W/S - throttle, A/D - bank by hand, Space - air brake. Too slow - it stalls.
The head-up display: speed, height, horizon, the bomb's impact point, the missile lock.

guide.airdefense.page.27:
GEAR

Helmets: 6B47, FAST, FAST with night goggles (N - goggles down / up).
Vests: plate carrier, heavy 6B45 - six pouches each, seen on you.
Pouch on the cursor, right-click the vest - on; empty hand - off.
guide.airdefense.page.28:
POUCHES

Magazines - quicker reload (15% each, up to three).
Grenades - B: a grenade without putting the gun away.
First aid - H: dress a wound in 1.5 s.
Radio - warns of missiles and drones coming at you.
Thermal monocular: hold RMB, Z - 2.5x / 6x.
tooltip.airdefense.ammo_crate: Open (RMB): three magazines for every gun on your hotbar.
guide.airdefense.page.29:
CITIES OF THE WORLD

Every country builds its own way: Soviet (panel blocks, dachas), European (tiled roofs, half-timbering, a church), American (brick walk-ups, suburbs, strip malls), desert (sandstone, domes, palms, a bazaar).
A town by the sea has a port: cranes, containers, a ship, a lighthouse.

guide.airdefense.page.30:
PEOPLE

Right-click anyone in a town: who he is, what he does, how the town lives. Trade, hire him for your town.
Your soldiers: "Follow me", "Hold here", "Back to your post".
Workers sleep at night, work by day.
guide.airdefense.page.31:
A SMARTER ARMY

Soldiers take cover, work round the flank of a dug-in enemy, shoot wide when pinned down.
The medic runs to the wounded and dresses them.
A man with a radio calls everyone near when he is hit.

guide.airdefense.page.32:
ARTILLERY

Howitzers (2S19 Msta-S, M109 Paladin) and the BM-21 Grad fire from far off at a point on the map: pick the gun on the tablet's map, mark the target, choose how many rounds, press "Fire!".
Shells fall in a spread round the target. You hear them whistle before they land.
guide.airdefense.page.33:
COUNTER-BATTERY

A counter-battery radar (Zoopark-1M, AN/TPQ-36) finds the guns that fire at you and marks them on the map with a red cross.
Your guns with "answer fire" on hit back by themselves. The enemy can do the same: after firing, drive off!
item.airdefense.vehicle.hint_recovery: Stand still: its crew mend your vehicles within 14 blocks
guide.airdefense.page.35:
ENEMY AIRCRAFT

In a war the enemy sends attack helicopters (Mi-24, Ka-52, AH-64) and jets (Su-25, A-10) at your towns: they fire rockets and the gun, drop bombs, then fly home.
Your air defence sees them on the radar and shoots them down - a hit aircraft falls burning. Keep a Pantsir or a Gepard by your towns!

guide.airdefense.page.36:
THE NAVY

Warships (Buyan-M, Visby) carry a gun, eight cruise missiles and a close-in gun of their own. Put one on the water, take the gunner's seat and aim with the mouse; missiles go from the tablet's map.
Coastal launchers (Bastion-P, NMESIS) sink ships: mark the ship on the map. In a war the enemy's ships come to your towns by the sea.
